name: The Steel Orphan (CR 1) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on The Steel Orphan (CR 1) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "The Steel Orphan (CR 8)" but are not part of the The Steel Orphan (CR 1) entry, which is unchanged.

Defensive Abilities hard to kill, improved uncanny dodge, recuperation, uncanny dodge; DR 1/—; Resist 5/acid while bloodraging

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fast movement
Melee +2 longsword +15/+10 (1d8+6, 19—20)
Ranged shortbow +8/+3 (1d6/x3)
Special Attacks bloodrage 26 rounds/day, 2 claws +15 (1d6+6, magic), fleet charge, mythic power 9/day, mythic rage, surge +1d6, tear apart, titan’s rage
Bloodrager Spells Known (CL 4th, concentration +6)

2nd Level (2/day)—blood armor, pouncing fury
1st Level (2/day)—break, mage armor, magic weapon, shieldB, true strike

Bloodline Draconic (steel)

Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 23
Traits Draconic Destiny, Draconic Lineage
Feats Dodge, Draconic Manifestation* (5 rounds/day), Eschew Materials*, Iron Will, Toughness*, Weapon FocusM (longsword), Weapon FocusM (claws)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Climb +14, Knowledge (arcana) +11, Perception +11, Survival +11
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ blood casting, draconic heritage
Gear belt of physical might +2 (Dex, Con) (10,000 gp), bloodrager’s kit (9 gp), +2 longsword (8,315 gp), potion of cure serious wounds (750 gp), +2 scale armor (4,200 gp), shortbow (30 gp) with 20 arrows (1 gp), 195 gp
